name: THE DOG'S OWNER
note: Doc 07 #18. 'Back alley. Looking for the lost dog from the notice board. The dog is on Main Street.' In the alley until Thad tells him there is a dog on Main Street (T_BILL_FOUND); from then on he is on Main Street with Bill, the street dog, and has no bark at all (doc 07 R_TRUTH: 'If resolved: he is on Main Street with Bill, and has no bark at all.' Read as his resolved state, not only that reputation's: a man standing beside his dog does not ask whether you have seen one). Who is present is decided as Thad arrives, so he stays in the alley for the visit he leaves in (errata 110).
greetsWithBarkNote: As the card sharp: TALK TO opens with his bark for the current reputation. Doc 07 writes no root line for him.
